modmenu.descriptionTranslation.frostedfo: Gradual, weather-aware snow on foliage. Entirely client-side.
frostedfoliage.command.reload: Frosted Foliage settings reloaded; changed depth/texture masks refresh automatically.
frostedfoliage.config.title: Frosted Foliage
frostedfoliage.config.load_error: Configuration could not be loaded. Fix the file and run /frostedfoliage reload before saving. %s
frostedfoliage.config.shared_note: These settings affect both trees and plants.
frostedfoliage.config.lists_note: Most players can leave these lists empty. Use them to add missing foliage or keep snow off specific blocks.
frostedfoliage.config.reload_note: Saving a change here briefly reloads resources.
frostedfoliage.config.may_reload_note: Saving a change here may briefly reload resources.
frostedfoliage.config.save_failed: Could not save Frosted Foliage settings
frostedfoliage.config.enabled.tooltip: Show foliage frost and ground snow.
frostedfoliage.config.whiteness.tooltip: Make foliage frost lighter or darker.
frostedfoliage.config.variation.tooltip: Vary how quickly nearby blocks gather snow.
frostedfoliage.config.leaf_coverage.tool: Limit how much of the leaf texture turns snowy.
frostedfoliage.config.leaf_depth.tooltip: 0% coats tops only. 100% covers the whole leaf block.
frostedfoliage.config.tops_first.tooltip: Coat leaf tops before sides and undersides.
frostedfoliage.config.tree_ground.toolti: Cover ground beneath trees when nearby ground has snow.
frostedfoliage.config.plants_enabled.too: Add frost to supported plants, including grass and flowers.
frostedfoliage.config.plant_depth.toolti: 0% is off. 100% coats the whole plant.
frostedfoliage.config.plant_coverage.too: Lower values leave more of the plant's color showing.
frostedfoliage.config.plant_ground.toolt: Cover ground beneath plants when nearby ground has snow.
frostedfoliage.config.gradual_buildup.to: Let snow build up over time. Off applies it immediately.
frostedfoliage.config.buildup_time.toolt: Time to reach full coverage during steady snowfall.
frostedfoliage.config.gradual_melting.to: Let snow fade after the melt delay. Off removes it in one step.
frostedfoliage.config.melt_time.tooltip: Time to melt after the delay. Snowy biomes take longer.
frostedfoliage.config.melt_delay.tooltip: Wait this long after snowfall ends. Doubles in snowy biomes.
frostedfoliage.config.canopy_delay.toolt: Higher values slow snow buildup beneath other leaves.
frostedfoliage.config.modded_foliage.too: Include leaves and supported plants from other mods.
frostedfoliage.config.quality.tooltip: Higher settings smooth out buildup but use more processing power.
frostedfoliage.config.refresh.tooltip: How often snow on screen updates. Less frequent refreshes reduce work.
frostedfoliage.config.cache_size.tooltip: Tracks this many 16x16x16 block sections. Higher limits use more memory.
frostedfoliage.config.include_blocks.too: Add blocks the mod missed. Use block IDs, such as minecraft:oak_leaves.
frostedfoliage.config.exclude_blocks.too: Keep snow off these blocks, even if included. Example: minecraft:oak_leaves.
frostedfoliage.config.extra_textures.too: Add missing textures for included blocks. Example: minecraft:block/fern.
